title: Short-lived SDK connections and the full five-cluster Production topology
notes: LaunchDarkly meters average concurrent server-side SDK connections and the plan ceiling is five, not the twelve containers the sandbox was sized for. Twelve long-lived clients would have exceeded the ceiling before August ended. Ordinary evaluators now connect only for the duration of each batch; the bounded Production rate probe keeps one sustained connection because its evaluations-per-hour figure only means anything if pacing stays continuous.

Cluster topology now comes from sandbox.json instead of a hardcoded three-cluster Production list, so all five Production clusters finally emit contexts. Clusters carry population weights and a rollout order, least-populated first, which makes a cluster-by-cluster rollout an accelerating curve: 5, 15, 30, 60, 100 per cent of Production traffic serving true.

The three pre-campaign repositories receive their first release tag here. They were created before the scenario existed and had none, which is why they alone jump to v001 while the Wave 1 additions advance to v004.

demo-pricing joins the Production deployment set so demo-tax-calculation-v2 has critical-environment evaluations to accumulate and later stop. demo-storefront and demo-profile keep Production and Staging only; Test and Dev gate nothing.
First step delivered entirely through squash-merged pull requests rather than direct commits to main.
